leftEvidence.title: Israel goes up after being told to turn away

points.label: Event action and claim
points.left: The people mourn, confess sin, and announce that they will go to the place the LORD promised.
points.right: The people admit sin, arm themselves, and treat ascent as easy after the sentence.

points.label: Response and consequence
points.left: Moses warns that the LORD is not among them; they presume to ascend without Moses or the ark and are struck down by Amalekites and Canaanites.
points.right: The LORD tells Moses to warn them not to go because he is not among them; they refuse, ascend presumptuously, and the Amorites chase them.

payload.posture: Numbers and Deuteronomy preserve confession, warning, divine absence, presumption, and defeat after the sentence.
payload.tension: Numbers names Amalekites and Canaanites; Deuteronomy names Amorites and does not explain the naming difference.
payload.title: The failed ascent in two witnesses
